packages.title: Shimla, Kullu & Manali Grand Holiday 9N/10D
packages.summary: Shimla, Kullu and Manali in a relaxed ten days.
highlights: Shimla, Kullu and Manali in a relaxed ten days.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Shimla
itinerary.description: Pickup in Delhi and drive (about 8 hrs) via the Chandigarh highway and the Kalka hills to Shimla. Evening on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri
itinerary.description: Breakfast and excursion to Kufri (pony rides and adventure park at own cost). Afternoon on Shimla's Mall Road and The Ridge, Christ Church and the Jakhu Temple. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla – Chail & Naldehra
itinerary.description: Breakfast and day trip to Chail with its palace and one of the world's highest cricket grounds, or to the golf meadows of Naldehra. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla – Kullu
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive via Sundernagar and Pandoh Dam to Kullu (about 7 hrs). Evening by the Beas. Overnight stay in Kullu.

itinerary.title: Kullu – Manikaran – Manali
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit Manikaran Sahib and Kasol in the Parvati valley, then continue to Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit the wooden Hadimba Devi Temple in the cedar forest, the Vashisht hot springs and temple, Manu Temple and the Club House; evening in Old Manali and on Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.description: Breakfast and excursion by local taxi to Solang Valley (ropeway, paragliding, snow activities in season at own cost), then through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul for snow views and the waterfall. Return to Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Naggar Castle & Jana Falls
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a drive along the left bank of the Beas to Naggar Castle and the Nicholas Roerich Art Gallery (closed Mondays), and the village waterfall at Jana (local Himachali lunch at own cost). Return to Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Chandigarh (about 8–9 hrs) for your onward journey. Tour ends.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh – Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, a visit to the Rock Garden and Sukhna Lake, then drive to Delhi (about 5 hrs) for your departure. Tour ends.

packages.title: Kullu Manali Honeymoon with Shimla 7N/8D
packages.summary: A slow honeymoon with four nights in Manali and romantic extras.
highlights: A slow honeymoon with four nights in Manali and romantic extras.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Shimla
itinerary.description: Pickup in Delhi and drive (about 8 hrs) via the Chandigarh highway and the Kalka hills to Shimla. Evening on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri
itinerary.description: Breakfast and excursion to Kufri (pony rides and adventure park at own cost). Afternoon on Shimla's Mall Road and The Ridge, Christ Church and the Jakhu Temple. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla – Kullu – Manali
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive (about 8 hrs) via Sundernagar lake and Pandoh Dam into the Kullu valley along the Beas river to Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit the wooden Hadimba Devi Temple in the cedar forest, the Vashisht hot springs and temple, Manu Temple and the Club House; evening in Old Manali and on Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.description: Breakfast and excursion by local taxi to Solang Valley (ropeway, paragliding, snow activities in season at own cost), then through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul for snow views and the waterfall. Return to Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Naggar & Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a relaxed visit to Naggar Castle and the Roerich Art Gallery (closed Mondays), then free time. Candle-light dinner at the hotel. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Chandigarh (about 8–9 hrs) for your onward journey. Tour ends.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh – Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, a short stop at the Rock Garden and drive to Delhi for your departure. Tour ends.
